description: This is a PHP source file defining an admin controller class `Pickup` for the OpenCart platform, handling shipping method configuration for pickup shipping options.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: Controller class for managing Pickup shipping method configuration in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the configuration page for the Pickup shipping method, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language, configuration settings, header, footer, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Pickup shipping configuration via POST request, verifying permissions, updating settings, and returning status as JSON.
